prompt: Which registered customers placed their very first order in May 2025, and placed it on the web? A customer's first order is the one with the earliest order_ts. order_ts holds the order time in UTC, and May 2025 runs from 1 May 00:00 up to but not including 1 June 00:00, UTC. Guest orders have a missing customer_id and do not count. Return one column, customer_id, with one row for each such customer. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the row filter: a web order in May 2025 that is also the earliest order of its own customer.
The earliest order time of a customer is one value; work it out in brackets for the customer on the row, not over all orders.
why_this_works: The subquery gives each customer's earliest order time, so a May 2025 web order passes only when it is that customer's first order.
